statement: The closest legal-domain framework paper is explicit that it does not report a benchmarked empirical comparison and is formal and diagnostic, so no version-level retrieval benchmark or measured temporal re-ranking result exists there; the resource gap for a measured, version-aware legal retrieval benchmark persists even though the concept is articulated.

evidence.quote: The paper does not report a benchmarked empirical comparison of existing systems; its contribution is formal and diagnostic
